company.name: Perfekto
company.shortDescription: Perfekto aims to reduce food waste by offering a subscription box of imperfect produce.
company.description: Perfekto offers imperfect produce delivered from farm to table, essentially building Imperfect Foods for Latam. Perfekto is a subscription box that includes food items that would otherwise be thrown away. Thereby creating a community of conscious buyers that value taste and quality instead of size or looks.
